name: application-workout-set-row
title: Workout Set Row
description: Per-set reps and weight input rows with a done checkbox for logging an exercise during a workout, plus a compact multi-exercise summary list showing overall completion status.
useWhen: Logging a workout in progress, where each set of an exercise needs its own editable reps/weight and a completion toggle.
Summarizing a workout's exercises and their completion status (complete, in progress, not started) in a single list.
avoidWhen: You need a generic 'add a row to a table' pattern with no fitness-specific fields — use inline-add-row instead.
Only aggregate exercise data is needed, not per-set granularity — a simpler summary card may suffice.
responsiveBehavior: The set-input grid uses a fixed 4-column template (set number, reps, weight, done) that stays legible on narrow viewports since each column is intentionally compact; the summary list is a single-column stack that reflows at any width.
accessibility: Each done checkbox carries an aria-label naming its specific set number (e.g. 'Set 1 done'), since the visual column header alone isn't repeated per row for assistive tech.
Reps and weight inputs use type="text" with real values rather than placeholder-only fields, so screen readers announce the current value, not just a hint.
Each summary row's status (Complete / In progress / Not started) is shown as explicit text, not color or icon alone.
